messages.content: "attachment style" ei concept ta actually ki explain kore?
Attachment style মানে ছোটবেলার early relationships থেকে গড়ে ওঠা একটা pattern, যা adult relationship এ কীভাবে closeness আর conflict handle করো সেটা influence করে - যেমন secure, anxious, avoidant।
ami kivabe bujhbo amar attachment style ki?

Nijer pattern lokkho koro - conflict e tumi kache asho naki dure jao, alone thakte comfortable lage naki anxious hoye jao partner er sathe contact na hole. Eta ekta signal dite pare, though official test o available.
